job.title: Learning & Development Manager
job.description:
• Learning & Development Manager – Recruitment & Sales Enablement
• $80,000–$100,000 base + performance bonus
• New York City, NY | Predominantly office-based

Join a specialist international recruitment business entering its next stage of US growth. With an established global operation and a growing New York team, the company is investing in the infrastructure that will help consultants ramp faster, perform consistently and build long-term careers. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how people are onboarded, coached and developed rather than inheriting a rigid training function. This is a highly visible role for someone who understands recruitment sales and wants to directly influence performance across the floor.

The Learning & Development Manager will own recruitment training, sales coaching and consultant development across the New York team.

Role Highlights
– Build and deliver structured onboarding and Academy programs for graduate and experienced hires
– Coach consultants live on cold calling, business development, recruitment fundamentals and sales conversations
– Create individual development plans and work alongside managers to improve performance and address underperformance
– Identify skill and performance gaps proactively through observation, activity data and regular interaction with consultants
– Measure the impact of development through productivity, ramp-up, progression, retention and commercial performance

You Will Need
– Strong first-hand recruitment or recruitment sales experience, with the commercial credibility to coach consultants effectively
– Evidence of developing others through mentoring, onboarding, call coaching, training sessions or performance improvement
– Confidence challenging behaviors, setting clear expectations and holding people accountable for agreed actions
– A proactive approach to identifying development needs rather than relying solely on managers to flag issues
– A genuine commitment to building a long-term career in learning, coaching, sales enablement or people development

Why You’ll Love It
– $80,000–$100,000 base salary
– Meaningful performance bonus designed around measurable development and business outcomes
– Opportunity to build and own a sales enablement function rather than simply deliver existing training materials
– Direct exposure to leadership with the autonomy to introduce new coaching processes and development programs
– Work closely with a growing New York recruitment team and see the impact of your coaching firsthand
– Play a central role in onboarding and developing future graduate intakes as the US business expands
– International business with opportunities for cross-office collaboration and longer-term mobility
– Structured career development supported by coaching, professional courses and additional learning opportunities
– Regular team incentives, social events and high-end dining experiences
– A collaborative environment that rewards commercial ambition alongside team development

job.description:
Salary: $115,000–$140,000 base + commission
Location: New York, NY | Hybrid - 4 days in office, 1 day remote
  
You’re already billing. Now it’s time to build something bigger.
  
We’re looking for a proven recruitment leader to take ownership of a high-performing Insurance Technology business within an established global financial services recruitment firm. This is not a step away from recruitment and into pure management. It’s a player-coach leadership opportunity for someone who wants to keep winning commercially while building a team, growing strategic accounts and increasing their earning potential.
  
The business is already significantly ahead of annual target, with multiple record months achieved in 2026 and established enterprise relationships creating substantial additional opportunity.
  
The Vice President, Insurance Technology will … lead from the front, combining personal production, strategic client development and team leadership to accelerate growth across the New York market.
  
Role Highlights
– Lead and develop a high-performing team of approximately 6 recruitment consultants
– Continue to personally bill while creating new revenue through senior-level relationships
– Own and expand strategic enterprise accounts across Insurance Technology
– Work alongside dedicated enterprise sales and key account teams to unlock cross-selling opportunities
– Help shape future team growth, desk strategy and the wider leadership structure
  
You Will Need
– Senior recruitment leadership experience at VP, Director, Senior Manager or equivalent level
– A proven personal billing record and genuine commercial drive
– Insurance Technology recruitment experience strongly preferred
– Experience leading teams or pods of approximately 4–8 consultants
– The confidence to win enterprise relationships, develop markets and generate demand rather than wait for vacancies
  
Why You’ll Love It
– $115,000–$140,000 base salary, with flexibility for exceptional candidates
– 25% commission up to threshold and 35% at higher billing levels, plus leadership/team override opportunities
– Join a business with multiple $1m–$2m billers and four consultants who billed $300k+ in Q2 alone
– Clear progression beyond VP level, with genuine scope to build teams and shape the business
– Healthcare, PTO, incentive trips, lunch clubs and best-in-class learning and development
– Relocation support available for experienced recruiters, including visa sponsorship and setup assistance
  
This is for someone who doesn’t want to manage from the sidelines. You’ll have the platform, accounts and infrastructure to perform, and the freedom to build on them.
  
If you’re a strong biller, a credible leader and ambitious enough to want more than a title, this is a conversation worth having.
